sn35.248:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave yavakalāpi cātummahāpathe nikkhittā assa
sn35.248:1.3: te yena yavakalāpiṃ chahi byābhaṅgīhi haneyyuṃ
sn35.248:1.4: evaṃ hi sā bhikkhave yavakalāpi suhatā assa chahi byābhaṅgīhi haññamānā
sn35.248:1.6: so taṃ yavakalāpiṃ sattamāya byābhaṅgiyā haneyya
sn35.248:1.7: evaṃ hi sā bhikkhave yavakalāpi suhatatarā assa sattamāya byābhaṅgiyā haññamānā.
sn35.248:1.8: evameva kho bhikkhave assutvā puthujjano cakkhusmiṃ haññati manāpāmanāpehi rūpehi …pe…
sn35.248:1.11: sace so bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano āyatiṃ punabbhavāya ceteti. evaṃ hi so bhikkhave moghapuriso suhatataro hoti. seyyathāpi sā yavakalāpi sattamāya byābhaṅgiyā haññamānāti. ekādasamaṃ.
sn35.248:2.2: atha kho bhikkhave vepacitti asurindo asure āmantesi
sn35.248:2.3: sace mārisā devāsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe asurā jineyyuṃ devā parājineyyuṃ yena naṃ sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha asurapuranti.
sn35.248:2.4: sakkopi kho bhikkhave devānamindo deve tāvatiṃse āmantesi
sn35.248:2.5: sace mārisā devāsurasaṅgāme samupabyūḷhe devā jineyyuṃ asurā parājineyyuṃ yena naṃ vepacittiasurindaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā mama santike āneyyātha sudhammaṃ devasabhanti.
sn35.248:2.6: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu.
sn35.248:2.7: atha kho bhikkhave devā tāvatiṃsā vepacittiasurindaṃ kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhitvā sakkassa devānamindassa santike ānesuṃ sudhammaṃ devasabhaṃ.
sn35.248:2.8: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave vepacitti asurindo kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandho hoti.
sn35.248:2.9: yadā ca kho bhikkhave vepacittissa asurindassa evaṃ hoti
sn35.248:2.10: dhammikā kho devā adhammikā asurā idānāhaṃ devapuraṃ gacchāmīti.
sn35.248:2.11: atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi muttaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreti.
sn35.248:2.12: yadā ca kho bhikkhave vepacittissa asurindassa evaṃ hoti
sn35.248:2.13: dhammikā kho asurā adhammikā devā tatthevadānāhaṃ asurapuraṃ gamissāmīti.
sn35.248:2.14: atha kaṇṭhapañcamehi bandhanehi bandhaṃ attānaṃ samanupassati dibbehi ca pañcahi kāmaguṇehi parihāyati.
sn35.248:2.17: maññamāno kho bhikkhave bandho mārassa amaññamāno mutto pāpimato.
sn35.248:3.1: asmīti bhikkhave maññitametaṃ ayamahamasmīti maññitametaṃ bhavissanti maññitametaṃ na bhavissanti maññitametaṃ rūpī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ arūpī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ saññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ asaññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ nevasaññināsaññī bhavissanti maññitametaṃ.
sn35.248:3.2: maññitaṃ bhikkhave rogo maññitaṃ gaṇḍo maññitaṃ sallaṃ
sn35.248:3.3: tasmā tiha bhikkhave amaññamānena cetasā viharissāmīti.
sn35.248:4.1: asmīti bhikkhave iñjitametaṃ ayamahamasmīti iñjitametaṃ bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ na bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ rūpī bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ arūpī bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ saññī bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ asaññī bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ nevasaññināsaññī bhavissanti iñjitametaṃ.
sn35.248:4.2: iñjitaṃ bhikkhave rogo iñjitaṃ gaṇḍo iñjitaṃ sallaṃ
sn35.248:4.3: tasmā tiha bhikkhave aniñjiyamānena cetasā viharissāmāti.
sn35.248:5.1: asmīti bhikkhave phanditametaṃ ayamahamasmīti phanditametaṃ bhavissanti …pe… na bhavissanti. rūpī bhavissanti. arūpī bhavissanti. saññī bhavissanti. asaññī bhavissanti. nevasaññināsaññī bhavissanti phanditametaṃ.
sn35.248:5.2: phanditaṃ bhikkhave rogo phanditaṃ gaṇḍo phanditaṃ sallaṃ.
sn35.248:5.3: tasmā tiha bhikkhave aphandiyamānena cetasā viharissāmāti.
sn35.248:6.1: asmīti bhikkhave papañcitametaṃ ayamahamasmīti papañcitametaṃ bhavissanti …pe… na bhavissanti. rūpī bhavissanti. arūpī bhavissanti. saññī bhavissanti. asaññī bhavissanti. nevasaññināsaññī bhavissanti papañcitametaṃ.
sn35.248:6.2: papañcitaṃ bhikkhave rogo papañcitaṃ gaṇḍo papañcitaṃ sallaṃ.
sn35.248:6.3: tasmā tiha bhikkhave nippapañcena cetasā viharissāmāti.
sn35.248:7.1: asmīti bhikkhave mānagatametaṃ ayamahamasmīti mānagatametaṃ bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ na bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ rūpī bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ arūpī bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ saññī bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ asaññī bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ nevasaññināsaññī bhavissanti mānagatametaṃ.
sn35.248:7.2: mānagatametaṃ bhikkhave rogo mānagatametaṃ gaṇḍo mānagatametaṃ sallaṃ.
